sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — WooCommerce Development Company Kochi

items.q: How is WooCommerce different from Shopify?
items.a: WooCommerce runs on WordPress, giving you full ownership of your store's code, data, and hosting, versus Shopify's closed, subscription-based platform. It suits businesses wanting more long-term control over customisation and costs.

items.q: Can you migrate our existing store to WooCommerce?
items.a: Yes — our WooCommerce migration services handle moving products, customer data, and order history from other platforms with minimal downtime.

items.q: Will our WooCommerce store be optimised for search engines?
items.a: Yes. WooCommerce SEO optimization is built into setup — product page structure, category organisation, and page speed are configured with search visibility in mind from the start.

items.q: How long does WooCommerce store development take?
items.a: A typical store, depending on catalogue size and custom features, takes 3–6 weeks from requirements review to launch. Larger catalogues with custom pricing rules or multiple shipping zones can take longer, and we'll give you a realistic timeline during the requirements review stage rather than a generic estimate upfront.

items.q: Do you handle payment gateway setup?
items.a: Yes. WooCommerce payment integration is included, covering the gateways relevant to your market — including options commonly used by Kerala businesses selling to both domestic and Gulf-based customers — tested thoroughly before launch.

items.q: Can you customize product pages to match our brand?
items.a: Yes — WooCommerce product page design is tailored to your brand and product type, not left as a default theme layout.
